# Lending Policy Review and Collateral Management

This document details critical actions required for the lending policy, specifically for strategy 2026.

## Key Action Items:

*   Monitor borrower credit scores to align with strategy 2026 objectives.
*   Review the current collateral value standards and implement necessary updates.
*   Investigate discrepancies or areas for improvement in collateral valuation standards.
*   Monitor collateral values based on audit findings and recommendations.
*   Optimize collateral values on a quarterly basis to ensure accuracy and relevance.
